Description

Lore

Long before the servers woke up, there was only static. Then came Deblox — a pocket universe stitched from forgotten places, midnight playgrounds, and worlds that never made it to the charts. Every experience is a door. Every player is a spark. Some doors lead to bright cities and kind strangers. Others hide things that smile too wide. The archive does not judge. It only remembers who walked through.
